_doc: View-dict fixture for Phase 3 PDF generation. Shape mirrors what api.services.report_data.build_view() returns: BQ batch_results columns + roof/nrel data fetched live (cached). One dim AND simple_payback_years are intentionally null to exercise the Rule-3 'unavailable' branch. simple_payback_years is null because Phase 3 has no cost model — keep it null to match build_view's contract.
narrative: This Echo Park single-family home shows strong rooftop solar potential. The Google Solar API estimates capacity for 24 panels and roughly 11,400 kWh/year of generation — enough to offset the bulk of an LADWP residential bill at the current ~$0.30/kWh tier. Ownership is high-confidence (LA County Assessor homeowner’s exemption on file), and the household sits below the area median income, which qualifies the lead for several state and federal incentives. Solar-array detection and intent signals are unavailable in this view; treat them as unknown rather than negative.
